description: Diagram 2, titled "Notifiable work in rooms containing a bath or shower", is a perspective view of a bathroom corner, showing two walls meeting at a vertical line and a floor. The lower part of both walls and the floor are shaded green. At the top, "See paragraphs 2.5 to 2.6" has a line pointing to the shaded area. A rectangular "Bath tub or shower tray" sits in the foreground. The left wall carries a tap-and-hose symbol above a circular symbol; the wall behind the bath carries a tap-and-hose symbol. Two horizontal dimensions of "600mm", bounded by dashed lines, mark a 600mm distance along each wall from the edge of the bath/shower tray, and a vertical dimension of "2.25m" runs from the floor to the top edge of the shading. At bottom left, "Additions and alterations to existing circuits are notifiable in the shaded area"; at bottom right, "NOTE: Socket-outlets should not be located within 3m of a bath tub or shower tray".
